weekly_forecast: This week, the cosmos are aligning for some truly questionable decision-making on the field. Expect unexpected thumb injuries to become a new trend in professional sports, prompting a national debate on the structural integrity of thumbs everywhere. Astrologers predict that one team will attempt to replace their quarterback with a sentient, highly-motivated crab, which will, surprisingly, not go as poorly as you might think. Don't be surprised if the halftime show features a dramatic reading of the Collective Bargaining Agreement, complete with interpretive dance.
